blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning has greatly advanced the capabilities of large language models, but its memory demands remain a barrier to broader adoption.
We introduce LoGRA, an approach to RL post-training that reduces memory by retaining useful learning signals in low-rank gradient sketches. These compact representations support both model updates and efficient policy synchronization. To prevent overly large updates from disrupting learning, we complement gradient compression with predicted-KL step control, which estimates policy changes before applying each update and adjusts its magnitude accordingly.
With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance.
It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical. Code is available in the Molt library .
blocks.zh:
强化学习大大提高了大型语言模型的能力,但其记忆需求仍然是更广泛采用的障碍.
我们引入了LoGRA,一种RL后训练的方法,通过低阶梯状草图保留有用的学习信号来减少记忆. 这些紧凑的表述支持模型更新和高效的政策同步. 为防止过多的更新会干扰学习,我们用预测-KL阶梯控制来补充梯度压缩,在应用每次更新之前估计政策变化并相应调整其规模.
随着所有技术的结合,LoGRA将平均训练内存在推理任务中的使用率降低至45.7%而不损害性能.
它还使27B参数模型能够在一个单一的8-GPU节点上对1 100多步进行稳定的训练,而密集的亚当则耗尽了内存,使以前的内存-不可行的RL训练变得实用. 代码在 Molt 库中可用 。

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key driver of advances in LLM, enabling models to improve through feedback on their own generated responses ( Sheng et al., 2024 ; , 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
However, its substantial memory requirements remain a major barrier to broader adoption. This challenge extends well beyond storing model parameters, as gradients and optimizer states can consume several times more memory than the weights themselves. For example, the BF16 weights of a 7B-parameter Qwen model ( Bai et al., 2023 ) require approximately 14 GB, while Adam’s ( Kingma and Ba, 2014 ) two FP32 moment buffers add another 56 GB, even before accounting for gradients and activations. Consequently, hardware capable of running a model may still be insufficient to improve it through RL. Reducing this memory overhead is therefore critical to making RL post-training accessible to the broader research community.
blocks.zh:
强化学习(RL)已成为LLM进步的关键驱动力,使模型能够通过对自身产生的响应的反馈来改进(Sheng等,2024;2025;徐等,2026;张等,2026b.).
然而,其实质性记忆要求仍然是更广泛采用的主要障碍。 这一挑战远远超出了模型参数的存储范围,因为梯度和优化状态可以消耗比重量本身多出数倍的内存. 例如,7B参数Quen模型(Bai等,2023年)的BF16重需要约14GB,而亚当(Kingma和Ba,2014年)的两个FP32瞬间缓冲器则会再加56GB,甚至在计算梯度和活化之前. 因此,能够运行一个模型的硬件可能仍然不足以通过RL改进. 因此,减少这种记忆费对于使更广泛的研究界能够获得远程教育培训至关重要。

blocks.en:
To overcome this bottleneck, existing approaches span both system-level optimizations and memory-efficient training algorithms.
At the system level, FSDP ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) shards training states across GPUs, gradient checkpointing ( Chen et al., 2016 ) reduces activation storage through recomputation, and CPU offloading moves selected training states to host memory ( Rajbhandari et al., 2020 ) .
Parameter-efficient methods reduce the number of parameters that require gradients and optimizer states: LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) , for example, freezes pretrained weights and learns small low-rank adapters.
Gradient compression offers another route ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2025 ; Hao et al., 2024 ) : they keep the original weight matrices trainable while using compact representations of gradients and optimizer states, thereby reducing training memory while still enabling effective updates to the full model.
blocks.zh:
为了克服这一瓶颈,现有方法跨越系统一级优化和内存效率高的培训算法。
在系统层面,FSDP(Zhao等,2023年)shards训练状态跨越了GPU,梯度检查(Chen等,2016年)通过再计算来减少活性存储,CPU卸载移动了选定的训练状态来托管内存(Rajbhandari等,2020年).
参数高效方法会减少需要梯度和优化态的参数数量: LoRA (Hu等,2021年) 例如,会冻结被预先训练的重量并学习小的低等适配器.
渐变压缩提供了另一种途径(Zhao等,2024;Su等,2025;Hao等,2024):在使用紧凑的梯度表示和优化状态的同时,它们保持了原有的重量矩阵可被训练,从而减少训练记忆,同时仍能有效更新到完整的模型.

blocks.en:
Motivated by this perspective, we introduce LoGRA, a method that uses low-rank gradient sketches to reduce the memory and communication costs of RL post-training, thus lower the hardware barrier.
Our intuition is that learning from rewards may require far less information than a full gradient can represent: with binary outcome rewards, each generated response receives only a single correctness signal, motivating a compact representation of the resulting learning signal ( Schulman and Lab, 2025 ) .
LoGRA directly accumulates sketches during backpropagation, avoiding the construction and storage of full gradients for the selected weight matrices. These sketches produce updates that are merged into the model weights, with directions that can vary throughout training. The same compact representation is then reused to synchronize the rollout policy, extending the benefits of compression from training memory to communication.
blocks.zh:
基于这个观点,我们引入了LoGRA,这是一种使用低等梯度素描的方法来降低RL后训练的内存和通信成本,从而降低硬件屏障.
我们的直觉是,从奖励中学习信息可能比整个梯度所能代表的信息要少得多:在二进制结果奖励下,每个生成的响应只收到一个单一的正确信号,激发了由此产生的学习信号的紧凑表现(Schulman and Lab, 2025).
LoGRA在回放过程中会直接积累草图,避免为所选重量矩阵构建并存储完整的梯度. 这些草图产生的更新被合并入了模型权重中,其方向在整个训练中可能有所不同. 同样的紧凑的表示再被重用来同步推出政策,将压缩的好处从训练内存扩大到通信.

blocks.en: LoGRA alone is insufficient to ensure stable updates: an overly large update can abruptly shift the policy and disrupt previously learned behavior. We therefore introduce predicted-KL step control, which estimates how much a proposed update would change the model’s next-token probabilities before applying it. This estimate guides the update scale to stay within a prescribed KL budget with simple optimizers.
blocks.zh: 仅靠LoGRA不足以确保稳定的更新:过于庞大的更新会突然改变政策并打乱以前学到的行为. 因此,我们引入了预测的KL步骤控制,该控制估计在应用模型之前,拟议更新将改变模型的下个概率。 这一估计指导更新尺度在规定的KL预算范围内保持简单的优化器.

blocks.en:
We evaluate LoGRA across multiple reasoning tasks with models ranging from 1.5B to 27B parameters. LoGRA reduces average training memory by 21.8% at 1.5B and 45.7% at 7B without sacrificing task performance. These savings also make larger-scale training feasible: LoGRA sustains stable learning of a 27B model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where the dense Adam baseline runs out of memory under the same hardware allocation.
Ablations further clarify how projection design and KL budgets affect learning performance and training stability.
blocks.zh:
我们评价LoGRA的多重推理任务,模型从1.5B到27B参数不等. LoGRA将平均训练内存在1.5B减少21.8%,在7B减少45.7%而不牺牲任务性能. 这些节余还使大规模培训成为可行: LoGRA在一个单一的8-GPU节点上持续稳定地学习一个超过1100个步骤的27B模型,在同一个硬件分配下密集的亚当基线会耗尽内存.
拨款还进一步澄清了预测设计和KL预算如何影响学习业绩和培训稳定性。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
An LLM contains large weight matrices, and storing a full gradient for each matrix adds substantial training memory.
LoGRA replaces these full gradients with compact sketches and represents each weight update as the product of two thin matrices.
We first describe this matrix representation, then explain its use in RL post-training and policy synchronization.
We use predicted-KL step control to determine the update magnitude.

我们首先描述这种矩阵表述,然后解释其在RL后培训和政策同步中的应用.
我们使用预测的 KL 步骤控制来确定更新的大小 。

An update that is small in parameter space can still substantially change the policy’s output probabilities.
Following the trust-region motivation of TRPO ( Schulman et al., 2015 ) , we therefore control the update magnitude using KL divergence between the current and proposed policies.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments to demonstrate that:
(1) LoGRA substantially improves training efficiency without compromising performance;
(2) predicted-KL enables stable single-node RL training for more than 1,000 steps; and
(3) ablation analyses provide deeper understanding of our method.
blocks.zh:
我们进行实验以证明:
(1) LoGRA在不损害业绩的情况下大幅度提高培训效率;
(2) 预测-KL可进行1 000多步的稳定单节点RL培训;以及
(3) 通缩分析使我们更深入地了解我们的方法。

blocks.en: 3.1 General Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 一般实验设置

blocks.en: We primarily evaluate Qwen models ranging from 1.5B to 27B parameters, including Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/7B and Qwen3.8-27B, on mathematical reasoning tasks. We also investigate long-horizon training of the 27B model on the Reasoning-Gym Hard mixture. Unless otherwise specified, we use PPO with verifiable rewards, sampling one response per prompt and using a global running reward baseline for advantage estimation. This deliberately simple setup isolates the effects of our method from potential gains introduced by more sophisticated RL algorithms. By default, all experiments run on a single node equipped with eight H100 80GB GPUs and 128 CPU cores, with four GPUs allocated to FSDP training and the remaining four to independent generation engines.

blocks.en: We primarily compare LoGRA with dense-gradient training on DAPO-Math-7.5K. We evaluate on MATH-500 every five updates for the 1.5B and 7B models and every ten updates for the 27B model. Each batch contains 128 prompts, with one response per prompt, a 4,096-token context limit, and one policy update using a global reward baseline. LoGRA uses rank-256 RowAdam with mismatch subtraction and a predicted-KL budget annealed from 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} to 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , whereas the dense baseline uses Adam with learning-rate annealing. We run three runs for 20,000 updates at 1.5B and 7B and 200 updates at 27B, retaining the 300-update annealing schedule for the latter.

blocks.en: We examine the effects of projection rank, basis refreshing, and projection distribution using Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B on DAPO-Math-7.5k with ranks r ∈ 4 , 16 , 64 , 256 r\in{4,16,64,256} . Fixed Rademacher projections sample matrices once with independent entries ± 1 / r \pm 1/\sqrt{r} , whereas refreshed Rademacher and Gaussian projections resample at every update. Following Flora’s motivation of avoiding confinement to a fixed low-rank subspace ( Hao et al., 2024 ) , we test whether refreshing benefits RL post-training. Each point represents one run, with MATH-500 pass@1 averaged over eight evaluations between steps 200 and 235. Figure (a) shows that rank has the strongest effect: increasing it from 4 to 256 improves pass@1 by 3.02–3.95 percentage points across configurations. At rank 256, fixed Rademacher, refreshed Rademacher, and refreshed Gaussian achieve 68.50 % 68.50\% , 68.31 % 68.31\% , and 67.42 % 67.42\% , respectively. Their ordering varies across ranks, showing no consistent benefit from refreshing, possibly because a fixed low-rank subspace captures sufficient task-relevant signal over this short training horizon.

Figures 5 (b) and 5 (c) evaluate gradient reconstruction quality. We use the initialization and checkpoints at steps 160 and 280 from one fixed-basis rank-64 training trajectory. At each model state, we sample one response for each of 4,096 prompts and divide them into 32 minibatches of 128 responses. All projection conditions use the same responses and dense gradients. Fixed bases are reused across minibatches, whereas refreshed bases are redrawn for each minibatch. For each rank, we evaluate eight projection seeds and compute the Frobenius cosine similarity between the dense gradient G G and its reconstruction for all 196 attention and MLP weight matrices. Each heatmap cell is averaged over the seven matrices in each Transformer layer, minibatches, model states, and projection seeds. Figure 5 (b) compares fixed and refreshed Rademacher projections, whereas Figure 5 (c) compares refreshed Rademacher and Gaussian projections.
Reconstruction quality exhibits a strong dependence on rank: the mean cosine similarity increases from approximately 0.046 0.046 at rank 4 to 0.348 0.348 at rank 256. By contrast, the largest difference between corresponding layer–rank cells is only 0.0014 0.0014 for fixed versus refreshed Rademacher projections and 0.0008 0.0008 for refreshed Rademacher versus Gaussian projections. Although the decrease in mean cosine under Gaussian projections is detectable at ranks 64 and 256, its magnitude remains below 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} .
Overall, projection rank has a substantially greater effect on single-minibatch gradient reconstruction than either basis refreshing or projection distribution.

blocks.en:
These results support the usefulness of predicted-KL step control with a conservative budget. The small constant budget improves tail accuracy over no control while maintaining stable learning. This is consistent with the trust-region motivation of TRPO ( Schulman et al., 2015 ) : limiting policy changes helps ensure that improvements predicted by a local objective translate into better performance, whereas overly large updates can undermine this approximation and destabilize training.
In our experiments, the large constant budget exhibits performance degradation, while the small and annealed budgets remain stable, with annealing achieving the highest mean tail accuracy. The no-control baseline also remains stable, and the separately collected annealed runs differ in their initial budget, so these two-seed results suggest a benefit from well-calibrated KL control without establishing that it is necessary for stability or that annealing alone explains the gain.
blocks.zh:
这些结果支持以保守的预算进行预测-KL步控的有用性. 小型常数预算在保持稳定学习的同时,提高了尾部准确度,而不是控制. 这与TRPO(Schulman等人,2015年)的信任区域动机是一致的:限制政策变化有助于确保地方目标预测的改进转化为更好的业绩,而过于庞大的更新可能会破坏这种近似性并破坏培训的稳定。
在我们的实验中,庞大的恒定预算显示性能退化,而小的和被遗忘的预算则保持稳定,其中被遗忘者实现了最高的正尾精度. 无控制基线也保持稳定,单独收集的无水蓄积量在初始预算中有所不同,因此这些两种子的结果表明,对KL的控制进行精细校正是有好处的,而没有确定稳定是必要的,或者单靠无水蓄积来解释收益.

blocks.en: 4 Related Works
blocks.zh: 4 相关工程

blocks.en: Large language models have emerged as a foundation for general-purpose problem solving ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) , with reinforcement learning (RL) becoming a critical post-training stage for advancing their capabilities ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) . However, scaling RL is more challenging than scaling SFT, as RL repeatedly alternates among response generation, reward evaluation, and policy optimization, requiring careful coordination of computation and memory across these stages.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型已成为解决一般用途问题的基础(Jimenez等,2024;Shao等,2018年)。 2024;谢等; 2024; 张等; 2024; 袁等; 2026.),强化学习(RL)成为提升自身能力的关键后培训阶段(郭等;2025;于等;2026;胡等;2025.). 然而,RL的缩放比SFT的缩放更具挑战性,因为RL在响应生成,奖励评价,政策优化中反复取而代之,需要仔细协调这些阶段的计算和内存.

blocks.en:
Recent work has addressed these challenges through asynchronous execution and more efficient resource management.
For example, asynchronous RL overlap rollout with policy training, reducing GPU idle time between stages ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
Other works improve resource allocation and scheduling to accommodate the distinct computational demands of generation and training ( Mei et al., 2025 ) .
Memory-saving techniques further enable larger models to fit within available hardware: sharding distributes training states across GPUs ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , activation checkpointing reduces memory consumption by recomputing intermediate activations ( Chen et al., 2016 ) , and CPU offloading transfers selected training states to host memory ( Rajbhandari et al., 2020 ) .
Our work complements them by compressing the gradients and optimization updates themselves, thereby reducing both training memory and communication overhead during policy synchronization.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作通过同步执行和更有效的资源管理来应对这些挑战。
例如,同步RL与政策培训重叠推出,减少GPU阶段之间的闲置时间(徐等,2026;张等,2026a.) 。 。 。 。
其他工程改善资源分配和时间安排,以满足不同的发电和培训计算需求(Mei等,2025年)。
内存保存技术进一步使更大型的模型能与可用的硬件相适应:sharding将训练状态分布在GPU(赵等,2023年),激活检查点通过重制中间活化来减少内存消耗(陈等,2016年),CPU卸载将选定的训练状态转移给主机内存(Rajbhandari等,2020年).
我们的工作通过压缩梯度和优化自我更新来补充它们,从而减少政策同步期间的培训记忆和通信间接费用。

blocks.en: Another line of work exploits low-rank structure to reduce training memory. LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) freezes pretrained weights and optimizes low-rank adapters, reducing the memory required for gradients and optimizer states. GaLore ( Su et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) and Flora ( Hao et al., 2024 ) instead keep the original weights trainable while compactly representing gradients and optimizer states. In contrast, LoGRA targets the RL training–generation loop: it accumulates low-rank sketches during backpropagation without materializing full gradients for selected weights and reuses the compressed updates for rollout-policy synchronization. It thus extends compression from training-state storage to gradient computation and policy communication.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作利用低级结构来减少训练记忆. LoRA (Hu et al., 2021)会冻结预受训练的重量并优化低等适配器,会降低梯度所需的内存并实现优化状态. GaLore(Su等,2025年;Zhao等,2024年)和Flora(Hao等,2024年)在紧凑地代表梯度和优化状态的同时保留了原有的重量可调节. 相比之下,LoGRA针对的是RL训练-生成回路:它在回路传播过程中会积累低等速写而未实现选定重量的全梯度并再利用压缩的更新来展开政策同步. 因此,它将压缩范围从培训状态存储扩大到梯度计算和政策沟通。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented LoGRA, a memory-efficient approach to LLM RL post-training that uses low-rank gradient sketches throughout gradient accumulation, weight updates, and policy synchronization. Our results show that compact gradient representations can substantially reduce training memory without sacrificing reasoning performance. In particular, LoGRA enables sustained training of a 27B model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam exceeds the available memory. Predicted-KL step control complements compression by regulating policy changes, with conservative budgets supporting stable long-horizon learning. Together, these findings highlight gradient representation as a practical lever for lowering the hardware barrier to RL post-training.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了LoGRA,一种对LLM RL后训练的内存高效方法,它在整个梯度积累、重量更新和政策同步过程中使用低等梯度草图。 我们的结果表明,紧凑的梯度表示可以大大减少训练记忆,而不会牺牲推理表现。 特别是,LoGRA使27B型号能够在一个单一的八GPU节点上持续地训练1100多步,密度亚当超过现有的内存. 预测-KL步骤控制通过调节政策变化来补充压缩,保守的预算支持稳定的长视距学习. 这些结论共同突出了梯度表示是降低RL培训后硬件障碍的实际杠杆。

blocks.en: We construct DAPO-Math-7.5K from the DAPO-Math-17k training split, using the corresponding release on Hugging Face ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . blocks.en: Evaluation uses all 500 problems in the test split of MATH-500 ( Lightman et al., 2023 ) . Each problem is converted to a user message, and its reference answer is stored as a string for the verifier. Training and evaluation use the model’s chat template.
